newsitem.title: CANADA: Comalco withdraws from Alumysa option.
newsitem.headline: Comalco withdraws from Alumysa option.

text.p: Noranda Inc and Comalco Ltd said on Thursday that Comalco was withdrawing from its option to buy into Noranda's Alumysa aluminum project in southern Chile.

Comalco said its first priorities were completing a major expansion at the Boyne Island smelter in Queensland, Australia and an upgrade at the Tiwai Point aluminum smelter in New Zealand, the companies said.
Comalco said it examined a number of smelting opportunities and still believed the Alumysa project "has the best potential of any greenfield opportunity examined."
Noranda said it remained committed to the project and would continue development. Finding a new partner was a top priority, Noranda said.
Noranda also said it would continue to try to buy additional water rights to expand annual capacity of the reduction plant to 420,000 tonnes from the original 270,000 tonnes.
Alumysa is an integrated hydroelectric aluminum reduction plant project.
Comalco is a majority-owned subsidiary of RTZ-CRA .
